DataType.Name: IOSRV_TO_GWB_LSP_DATA
DataType.Content:
TYPE IOSRV_TO_GWB_LSP_DATA : STRUCT
LOAD:ARRAY[1..nLOAD] OF HMI_LOAD_DATA; (*load data array for the load shed screen of data type LOAD_DATAOUT*) CONTINGENCY:ARRAY[1..nCONT] OF HMI_CONTINGENCY_DATA; (*Contingency data array for the contingency summary screen of data type*) Disable_LSP_A:BOOL; (*Disables LSP A *) Disable_LSP_B:BOOL; (*Disables LSP B *) Disable_LSP:BOOL; (*Master Disable*) Test_Mode:BOOL; (*Test shed *) Copy_Data_From_LSPA_to_LSPB:BOOL; (*Copy set points from LSP B*) Copy_Data_From_LSPB_to_LSPA:BOOL; (*Copy set points from LSP A*) HMI_InitialReadComplete:BOOL; (*HMI initial read complete*) UF_L1_Load_To_Shed:REAL; (*Level 1 load to shed*) UF_L2_Load_To_Shed:REAL; (*level 2 load to shed*) Priority_List: ARRAY[1..nLOAD] OF WORD; (*load priority from HMI*) CLEAR:BOOL; (*CLear load shed and cont flags*) Enable_LSP:BOOL; DataChanged:BOOL; (*Data changed bit*)
END_STRUCT END_TYPE
